# PainRadar

> PainRadar is a SaaS idea discovery and validation tool. It analyzes online discussions (Reddit, forums, review sites) to surface recurring customer pain points, scores them as product opportunities, and generates product ideas with SEO angles. Available in English and French.

## What it does

PainRadar analyzes thousands of real user discussions to detect recurring complaints and frustrations. Each pain point is scored for demand, urgency, competition, and monetization potential — then turned into AI-ready product ideas, SEO keyword opportunities, and acquisition channel recommendations.

## Who it's for

- Indie hackers and solo founders looking for validated SaaS ideas
- Product teams validating new features or pivots
- Startup founders who want evidence before building

## Key features

- Pain point detection from Reddit, G2, Capterra, Trustpilot, and community forums
- Opportunity scoring (0–100) across demand, urgency, competition, and monetization
- AI-generated product ideas with MVP scope and differentiation angles
- SEO keyword discovery from real customer language
- Acquisition channel mapping
- Competitive landscape overview
- Export as JSON or PDF

## Pricing

- **Free**: 2 credits at signup, no credit card required. Basic pain point detection + opportunity scoring.
- **Starter**: €9 one-time — 5 full analysis credits. Includes product ideas, SEO keywords, acquisition channels, AI-ready prompts, export. Credits never expire.
- **Explorer**: €19 one-time — 15 full analysis credits. Same as Starter plus priority email support.
- **Founder**: €49 one-time — Unlimited analyses forever. No credits to track. Priority feature access + dedicated support.

Full pricing: https://painradar.com/pricing

## Compared to alternatives

| Tool | Focus | Model |
|------|-------|-------|
| PainRadar | Pain points → validated product ideas | One-time credits |
| Exploding Topics | Search trend detection | Subscription |
| BigIdeasDB | Review mining | Subscription |
| GummySearch | Reddit browsing (closed Nov 2025) | Was subscription |
| IdeaBrowser | Curated ideas | Subscription |
